concept: S3 Glacier Deep Archive: lowest-cost archive
tests: Choosing a storage class for a rarely accessed archive with retrieval within 12 hours.
expected: S3 Glacier Deep Archive — the cheapest class, Standard retrieval within 12 h. Triggers: "archival", "rarely accessed", "retrieval within 12 hours", "lowest storage cost".
why_not: Standard and Standard-IA are more expensive for archives; Intelligent-Tiering — monitoring fee, for unknown access patterns.
